remarks: Discover the perfect blend of privacy, modern comfort, and natural beauty in this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home, nestled within a gated property with breathtaking pond views visible from most rooms. Step into the beautiful kitchen, featuring stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, a gas cooktop, and a double oven-perfect for culinary enthusiasts. Adjacent to the kitchen, the formal dining room and living room provide an elegant setting for gatherings. The spacious family room is a true retreat, boasting vaulted ceilings and a toasty wood-burning stove, where you can enjoy stunning water views on cozy winter days. During warmer months, relax or entertain on the large screened porch and expansive deck, seamlessly blending indoor and outdoor living.  The home also includes additional space for an office or recreation room, catering to today's work-from-home or leisure needs. This home is equipped with a high-efficiency gas heating system and a tankless hot water heater. The large finished lower level offers endless possibilities, featuring space for a workshop, play/entertainment area, ample room for a home gym with scenic pond views, plenty of storage, and a walkout to the lower patio for easy outdoor access. The two-car garage provides additional convenience and storage. A rare opportunity to own a tranquil waterfront retreat.
